statement:
by
  classical
  let S := fun {r s : ℕ} (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) (β : DirichletCharacter ℂ s) (m : ℕ) =>
    ∑' q : ℕ, if hq : q ≠ 0 then
      let _ : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
      if h : r ∣ q ∧ s ∣ q then
        let A := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.1 α
        let B := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.2 β
        gaussSum A ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum B ZMod.stdAddChar *
          gaussSum (A*B)⁻¹ (ZMod.stdAddChar.mulShift (-(m:ZMod q))) / (q.totient:ℂ)^2
      else 0
    else 0
  let O := S (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  exact ∀ (r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r), α.IsPrimitive →
    ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → Even m →
    ∀ F : Finset (Σ s : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ s),
    (∀ b ∈ F, b.1 ≠ 0 ∧ b.2.IsPrimitive ∧ ‖O m‖ < Real.sqrt 2 * ‖S α b.2 m‖) →
    F.card ≤ 24

plain_statement.zh: 固定原始特征 α 和正偶数 m，允许另一原始特征 β 在所有正导子间变化。扭曲奇异级数绝对值超过普通值 1/√2 的不同搭档（导子，β）总共至多 24 个，原来的例外类也计入。
plain_statement.en: Fix a primitive character and a positive even target. Across all positive conductors, at most 24 primitive partners have twisted magnitude above 1/sqrt(2) of the ordinary magnitude, including the exceptional class.

brief.zh: 复用 WeiKun 的 #4106 和 #4023 的非零支撑。先把乘积特征送到共同模数，利用本原诱导的唯一性跨导子去重。例外类的乘积导子整除 36。非例外高值要求 5∤m；在 5 处检查 Jacobi 和，尝试排除平凡搭档与逆搭档，再证明两类何时能共存。仅得 φ(180)=48 不够。此界控制大搭档数，零点重数仍需另估。
brief.en: Use #4106 and the nonzero-support criterion in #4023. Lift to a common modulus and prove injectivity after primitive induction. Exceptional product conductors divide 36. In the other case test the modulo-five Jacobi sums for trivial and inverse partners, then show when the cases can coexist. The crude ceiling phi(180)=48 does not suffice. Zero multiplicities are separate.
